sn52.3:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Anuruddho Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Sutanutīre || || 2.
sn52.3:1.2: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yenāyasmā Anuruddho tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Anuruddhena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu || ||
sn52.3:1.3: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyam vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || 3. Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū āyasmantam Anuruddham etad avocuṃ || ||
sn52.3:1.4: Katamesaṃ āyasmā Anuruddho dhammānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā mahābhiññātam patto ti || || 4
sn52.3:2.1: Catunnam khvāham āvuso satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā mahābhiññātam patto ||
sn52.3:2.3: Idhāham āvuso kāye kāyānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ ||
sn52.3:2.6: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharāmi || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || ||
sn52.3:2.7: Imesaṃ khvāham āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā mahābhiññātam patto || || 5.
sn52.3:2.8: Imesaṃ ca panāham āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā hīnaṃ dhammaṃ hīnato abbhaññāsiṃ || majjhimaṃ dhammam majjhimato abbhaññāsiṃ || paṇītaṃ dhammam paṇītato abbhaññāsin
